mock_data.title: A Letter of Apology
mock_data.passage:
Furniture By Design

10 Greenwood, London WC2H 8TJ
Tel: 020-6788 0001

15 April 2002

Mrs Marjorie Wood
12 Castle Road
Blandwell, BL3 6NB

Dear Mrs Wood,

I was extremely concerned to receive your letter dated 12 April. Please accept my profuse apologies for the inconvenience which you experienced in connection with the late arrival of the furniture which you ordered from us. I understand that the sofa beds were delivered to you yesterday safe and sound.

I have investigated this matter thoroughly and, it appears, that our advertising campaign was successful beyond any of our expectations. Our entire range of furniture, and especially the sofa beds, sold like hot cakes. This meant that, to some extent, we were victims of our own success. We simply did not have enough stock in our warehouses to meet the extraordinary demand. We had been prepared for the race against time to get all the orders fulfilled before Christmas, but not with the lack of product.

This would not normally be a problem as we deal with extremely efficient and speedy suppliers. Usually they are second to none in their reliability. However, it appears that they experienced a slight technical hitch in their new computerized production process and were unable to supply us with as much furniture as we required. Their maintenance people had their work cut out to get their production line functioning again in time for the Christmas rush and valuable time was lost.

We searched around for another supplier to help us out, but to no purpose. Being unwilling to accept goods of a lesser quality, we had no choice but to wait for our usual supplier to get their machinery fixed. When all is said and done, quality is what matters to most of our customers.

I was sorry to hear that you had such problems with our complaints procedure. I have discovered that these were due to a serious reduction in the number of our helpline staff available then, owing to a local flu epidemic.

I am sorry that this has been such a chapter of accidents. As I have indicated, most of it was a result of circumstances beyond our control. Once again, my apologies for the inconvenience caused to you. We value your custom greatly and hope that you will go on being a client of the company.

Yours sincerely,
Ernest Blake
Chief Executive

Dear Mrs Wood,

I was very sorry to get your letter from 12 April. I want to say I am very sorry for the problems you had with the late delivery of your furniture. I know that the sofa beds arrived yesterday and were in good condition.

I have looked into this. It seems our advertising was more successful than we thought. We sold a lot of furniture, especially sofa beds. We sold so much that we didn't have enough in our warehouse. We were successful, but we didn't have enough products to sell.

We wanted to get all the orders delivered before Christmas, but we didn't have enough furniture. This is not usually a problem because our suppliers are usually very reliable and fast. But they had a small problem with their new computer system. They could not send us as much furniture as we needed. They had to fix the system to get it working again for Christmas.

We tried to find another supplier to help us, but we couldn't find one. We didn't want to sell furniture that was not as good quality. So, we had to wait for our usual supplier to fix their machines. We think quality is very important to our customers.

I am sorry to hear you had problems with our complaints process. I found out that we had fewer people working on the helpline because many people were sick with the flu.

I am sorry that so many things went wrong. Most of the problems were things we couldn't control. Again, I apologize for the problems this caused you. We value your business and hope you will continue to be our customer.

Yours sincerely,
Ernest Blake
Chief Executive

15 April 2002

Mrs Marjorie Wood
12 Castle Road
Blandwell, BL3 6NB

Dear Mrs Wood,

I am writing with regard to your letter of 12th April and must express my sincere regret concerning the difficulties you encountered due to the delayed delivery of your furniture order. I understand that the sofa beds were, in fact, delivered yesterday and arrived in good condition.

Following a thorough investigation, it has become clear that the unforeseen success of our recent advertising campaign led to a surge in demand that outstripped our available stock, particularly with respect to our sofa bed range. To a certain extent, therefore, we became victims of our own success. While we had anticipated the usual pre-Christmas rush and geared up accordingly, we were simply not prepared for such a precipitous shortfall in product availability.

Ordinarily, this would not have presented an insurmountable challenge, as we typically rely on suppliers renowned for their efficiency and reliability. However, it appears they experienced an unexpected setback in the form of a technical malfunction in their newly implemented computerized production process, which hampered their ability to fulfil our orders in a timely manner. Their maintenance teams worked tirelessly to restore the production line to full functionality in time for the Christmas peak, but valuable time was, regrettably, lost.

Despite our best efforts to source alternative suppliers who could assist in meeting the escalating demand, we were ultimately unsuccessful. Unwilling to compromise on our commitment to quality by accepting substandard goods, we felt we had no option but to weather the storm and await the resolution of the technical issues at our primary supplier. Ultimately, we believe that maintaining the high standards our customers expect is paramount.

I was most concerned to learn of the issues you experienced with our complaints procedure. My investigation revealed that these problems stemmed from a significant reduction in the number of available helpline staff at that time, a situation exacerbated by a local influenza epidemic.

I appreciate that this series of unfortunate events has been highly frustrating, and I can only reiterate that many of the factors contributing to the delay were, as I have outlined, largely beyond our direct control. Once again, please accept my sincerest apologies for the inconvenience caused. We place immense value on your custom and sincerely hope that you will remain a valued client of Furniture By Design.

Yours sincerely,

Ernest Blake
Chief Executive

Furniture By Design

10 Grinvud, London WC2H 8TJ
Tel: 020-6788 0001

15 aprel 2002

Xonim Marjori Vud
12 Kasl Roud
Blandvel, BL3 6NB

Hurmatli xonim Vud,

12 aprel sanali xatingizni olganimdan juda xavotirlandim. Iltimos, bizdan buyurtma qilgan mebelning kechikib yetib kelishi bilan bog'liq noqulaylik uchun ko'p uzrlarimni qabul qiling. Tushunaman, divan-karavotlar kecha sizga sog'-salomat yetkazib berilgan.

Men bu masalani puxta o'rgandim va ko'rinib turibdiki, bizning reklama kampaniyamiz barcha kutganlarimizdan ham muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi. Mebelimizning barcha assortimenti, ayniqsa divan-karavotlar, qizg'in sotildi. Bu ma'lum darajada biz o'z muvaffaqiyatimizning qurboni bo'lganligimizni anglatadi. Bizda omborimizda favqulodda talabni qondirish uchun yetarli mahsulot zahirasi yo'q edi. Biz Rojdestvodan oldin barcha buyurtmalarni bajarish uchun vaqt bilan poygaga tayyorlanganmiz, ammo mahsulot etishmasligi bilan emas.

Bu odatda muammo bo'lmas edi, chunki biz juda samarali va tez ta'minotchilar bilan ishlaymiz. Odatda ular ishonchlilik bo'yicha eng yaxshilaridan biri. Biroq, ko'rinib turibdiki, ular yangi kompyuterlashtirilgan ishlab chiqarish jarayonida ozgina texnik nosozlikni boshdan kechirdilar va bizga kerak bo'lgan mebelni yetkazib bera olmadilar. Ularning ta'mirlash xodimlari Rojdestvo shoshilishi uchun o'z ishlab chiqarish liniyasini yana ishlatishga juda qattiq harakat qilishdi va qimmatli vaqt yo'qotildi.

Biz bizga yordam beradigan boshqa ta'minotchini qidirdik, ammo foydasiz. Kam sifatli mahsulotlarni qabul qilishni istamay, biz oddiy ta'minotchimiz mashinasini tuzatguncha kutishdan boshqa ilojimiz yo'q edi. Oxir-oqibat, mijozlarimizning ko'pchiligi uchun sifat muhimdir.

Shikoyat tartibimiz bilan bunday muammolarga duch kelganligingizdan afsusdaman. Men bularning mahalliy gripp epidemiyasi tufayli yordam liniyasi xodimlarimiz sonining jiddiy kamayishi sababli yuzaga kelganini aniqladim.

Kechirasiz, bu shunday baxtsiz hodisalar ketma-ketligi bo'ldi. Ko'rsatganimdek, buning ko'p qismi bizning nazoratimizdan tashqari vaziyatlar natijasi edi. Yana bir bor, sizga keltirilgan noqulaylik uchun uzr so'rayman. Biz sizning mijozligingizni juda qadrlaymiz va kompaniyaning mijozi bo'lib qolishingizga umid qilamiz.

Hurmat bilan,
Ernest Bleyk
Bosh direktor

“Furniture By Design”
10 Greenwood, London WC2H 8TJ
Tel: 020-6788 0001

2002 yil, 15 aprel

Marjorie Vud xonimga
12 Castle Road
Blandwell, BL3 6NB

Hurmatli Vud xonim,

12 apreldagi xatingizni olganimdan juda afsusdaman. Sizning mebellaringizning kech yetkazib berilishi bilan bog‘liq muammolar uchun juda kechirim so‘ramoqchiman. Bilaman, divan-krovatlar kecha yetib kelgan va yaxshi holatda edi.

Men buni o‘rganib chiqdim. Ko‘rinishidan, reklamamiz biz o‘ylagandan ham muvaffaqiyatli bo‘ldi. Biz juda ko‘p mebel, ayniqsa, divan-krovatlar sotdik. Shunchalik ko‘p sotdikki, omborimizda yetarli emas edi. Biz muvaffaqiyatli bo‘ldik, lekin sotish uchun yetarli mahsulotimiz yo‘q edi.

Biz Rojdestvodan oldin barcha buyurtmalarni yetkazib bermoqchi edik, lekin yetarli mebelimiz yo‘q edi. Odatda bu muammo emas, chunki yetkazib beruvchilarimiz odatda juda ishonchli va tezkor. Ammo ularning yangi kompyuter tizimida kichik muammo bor edi. Ular bizga kerak bo‘lgancha mebel yubora olmadilar. Ular Rojdestvo uchun qayta ishlashi uchun tizimni tuzatishlari kerak edi.

Biz yordam berish uchun boshqa yetkazib beruvchini topishga harakat qildik, lekin topa olmadik. Biz sifati yaxshi bo‘lmagan mebellarni sotishni xohlamadik. Shunday qilib, biz odatdagi yetkazib beruvchimizning mashinalarini tuzatishini kutishimiz kerak edi. Biz sifat mijozlarimiz uchun juda muhim deb o'ylaymiz.

Sizning shikoyatlar jarayoni bilan bog'liq muammolaringizni eshitib afsusdaman. Men bilib oldimki, yordam liniyasida kamroq odam ishlagan, chunki ko'pchilik gripp bilan kasal edi.

Shuncha narsa noto'g'ri ketganidan afsusdaman. Muammolarning aksariyati biz nazorat qila olmaydigan narsalar edi. Yana bir bor, sizga yetkazilgan muammolar uchun kechirim so‘rayman. Biz sizning biznesingizni qadrlaymiz va umid qilamizki, siz bizning mijozimiz bo'lib qolasiz.

Hurmat bilan,
Ernest Bleyk
Bosh direktor

Ularning texnik xizmat ko'rsatish guruhi Rojdestvo shovqini oldidan ishlab chiqarish liniyasini qayta ishga tushirish uchun qattiq mehnat qildi va bu vaqt yo'qotilishiga olib keldi.

Bizga yordam berish uchun muqobil yetkazib beruvchilarni qidirdik, ammo befoyda. Sifati pastroq mahsulotlarni qabul qilishni istamaganligimiz sababli, odatdagi yetkazib beruvchimizning uskunalarini tuzatishini kutishdan boshqa ilojimiz yo'q edi. Oxir oqibat, sifat bizning mijozlarimiz uchun eng muhim narsa.

Bizning shikoyatlar jarayoni bilan bog'liq muammolar haqida eshitganimdan juda afsusdaman. Ma'lum bo'lishicha, bu muammolar o'sha paytda mahalliy gripp epidemiyasi tufayli yordam liniyasi xodimlarining soni sezilarli darajada kamayganligi sababli yuzaga kelgan. Bizda xodimlar yetishmas edi va bu xizmatimizga ta'sir qildi.

Bu vaziyat shunchalik ko'p afsuslanarli voqealarni o'z ichiga olganidan afsusdaman. Tushuntirganimdek, buning ko'p qismi bizning nazoratimizdan tashqari holatlar tufayli yuzaga keldi. Yana bir bor, noqulayliklar uchun uzr so'rayman. Biz sizning xaridoringizni juda qadrlaymiz va kompaniyamizning mijoz bo'lib qolishingizga umid qilamiz. Biz xizmatimizni yaxshilashga va kelajakda shunga o'xshash muammolarni oldini olishga sodiqmiz.

Hurmat bilan,
Ernest Bleyk
